rows.candidate2_name: Julia Letlow → John Fleming (R Runoff, June 16)
rows.notes: GOP Runoff: Julia Letlow (45%) vs. John Fleming (28%) on June 27, 2026. Incumbent Bill Cassidy (R) eliminated with 25% — first incumbent senator to lose a primary since 2012. Cassidy had voted to convict Trump at his 2021 impeachment trial. Democratic runoff: Jamie Davis (47%) vs. Nick Albares (26%) also on June 27. Winner of GOP runoff heavily favored in the November 3 general election.

rows.candidate2_name: John Cornyn → Ken Paxton (R Runoff, May 27)
rows.notes: R primary runoff May 26: John Cornyn vs. Ken Paxton. Winner faces Democrat James Talarico in the November general election. (Trump has endorsed Paxton; Cook Political rates race Lean R if Cornyn wins, Toss-up if Paxton wins.)
